breakdown.description: The given relative velocities/angles imply different axial components, contradicting the statement that axial velocity is constant.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly identifies and resolves the inconsistency. It computes Va = W1·cos(beta1) and then recalculates W2 = Va/cos(beta2) ≈ 122.5 m/s, exactly matching the ground truth approach of enforcing constant axial velocity rather than using the inconsistent W2=100 m/s.
